blocks.text: A malaria case is a person with malaria infection, confirmed by microscopy or mRDT, regardless of whether fever and other clinical symptoms are present.

blocks.text: Asymptomatic malaria case can be found during Active Case Detection (ACD) by health workers in the community and in households. Therefore, all patients with parasitemia are considered “malaria cases”, regardless of whether clinical symptoms are present or not.
